prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a parking lot collision. The patient had 24 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1443; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Nearly all findings rest on the patient's own pain reports; imaging and exam tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text:
Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot, reporting neck pain and stiffness consistent with a whiplash mechanism. The reported injury is in keeping with the kind and force of the impact. No prior injury to the cervical region is known to this provider. Over the course of 24 visits, care included manual therapy, range-of-motion exercises, and a home stretching program. Treatment followed a typical progression, with visit frequency tapering as symptoms improved and function returned. Nearly all of the documented symptoms rest on the patient's own descriptions of pain, as cervical imaging and standard clinical examination maneuvers were within normal limits. Billed services reflect the planned course of care, with no repeated or duplicate charges identified. Discharge plan includes continued self-directed exercise and follow-up as needed.
